LanguageData.Gun_PPSh-41d_RWP.label: PPSh-41 (Drum)
LanguageData.Gun_PPSh-41d_RWP.description: The PPSh-41 (Drum) is a rapid-firing submachine gun renowned for its high rate of fire and durability. Equipped with a large drum magazine, it excels in close-quarters combat, allowing the wielder to unleash a barrage of bullets quickly. Perfect for overwhelming enemies with sheer volume of fire, but its accuracy decreases significantly over longer distances.
